versions.content: {DRAFT} For each Synchronized Time Base • configured as a Global Time Master • and to be stored non-volatile (i.e., StbMStoreTimebaseNonVolatile == STORAGE ) • and using a Disciplined HW Clock (i.e., StbMDisciplinedClock is con- figured), when the stored backup time has been successfully loaded from NvM , then the StbM shall call EthIf_SetPhcTime to set the value of the Disciplined HW Clock to the backup time read from NvM . If loading from NvM fails, then the StbM shall call EthIf_SetPhcTime to set the value of the Disciplined HW Clock to 0.
